article_title: Diabetes and ADHD drugs to be tested on Alzheimer's patients in new study

tasks.prompt: What is the main purpose of the AD-SMART trial?
options: To compare Alzheimer's rates in different parts of the UK.
To speed up the testing of several possible Alzheimer's treatments at the same time.
To replace cognitive tests with blood tests.
To prove that all diabetes medicines prevent dementia.
tasks.correct_answer: To speed up the testing of several possible Alzheimer's treatments at the same time.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: מטרת המחקר היא להאיץ את בדיקתן של כמה תרופות אפשריות במקביל, במקום לבדוק תרופה אחת בכל פעם.

tasks.prompt: Which two medicines will the trial test first?
options: Metformin and atomoxetine
Insulin and aspirin
Atomoxetine and a new cancer drug
Metformin and a vaccine
tasks.explanation_hebrew: התרופות הראשונות הן metformin, המשמשת לסוכרת מסוג 2, ו־atomoxetine, המשמשת ל־ADHD.

tasks.prompt: What does “repurposed medicines” mean in this article?
options: Medicines that failed every previous safety test
Medicines used only as placebos
Existing medicines being tested for a different medical use
Medicines manufactured from recycled packaging
tasks.correct_answer: Existing medicines being tested for a different medical use
tasks.explanation_hebrew: repurposed medicines הן תרופות קיימות שנועדו במקור למצבים אחרים וכעת נבדקות לשימוש חדש נגד אלצהיימר.

tasks.prompt: How many people with mild to moderate Alzheimer's are expected to join the study?
options: About 120
About 600
More than 30
About 1,200
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מציינת שהמחקר יגייס כ־1,200 משתתפים ביותר מ־30 אתרים בבריטניה.

tasks.prompt: Why do participants have a higher chance of receiving an active treatment in this platform trial than in a traditional trial?
options: Several treatment groups share one placebo comparison group.
The trial has no placebo group at all.
Every participant takes both medicines together.
Only people who respond well are enrolled.
tasks.correct_answer: Several treatment groups share one placebo comparison group.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: מכיוון שכמה זרועות טיפול מושוות לקבוצת פלצבו משותפת אחת, חלק גדול יותר מהמשתתפים יכול לקבל טיפול פעיל.

tasks.prompt: In the phrase “the drug can be dropped quickly”, what does “dropped” mean?
options: Accidentally spilled
Lowered to a smaller dose
Removed from the trial because it is not showing benefit
Delivered directly to participants' homes
tasks.correct_answer: Removed from the trial because it is not showing benefit
tasks.explanation_hebrew: dropped בהקשר המחקרי פירושו להפסיק לבדוק תרופה שאינה מראה תועלת, כדי לפנות מקום לטיפול אחר.

tasks.prompt: What must the study show for a drug to be considered successful? Give two outcomes.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין שני מדדים מרכזיים מן הכתבה: שיפור בחשיבה ושיפור בתפקוד היומיומי.
expected_points: A beneficial effect on thinking or cognition.
A beneficial effect on the ability to carry out everyday activities.
An improvement that matters to patients and carers, not only a laboratory change.

tasks.prompt: Summarise how the AD-SMART platform design is intended to shorten the search for Alzheimer's treatments.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר בדיקה במקביל, קבוצת פלצבו משותפת, הפסקה מהירה של תרופה לא מועילה והוספת טיפולים חדשים.
expected_points: Several treatments are tested simultaneously against one placebo group.
Treatments that do not show benefit can be removed quickly.
New candidate drugs can be added without starting an entirely separate trial.
The model adapts methods already used in cancer and motor neurone disease research.

tasks.prompt: Why did joining the trial help Angela Bucksey and her husband feel less powerless after her diagnosis?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לקשר בין דבריהם לבין פעולה, תקווה ותרומה למחקר, בלי לטעון שהטיפול כבר הוכח כיעיל.
expected_points: Angela said taking part meant doing something rather than simply waiting.
She described participation as a way to fight back and not let Alzheimer's define her.
Her husband said the trial helped move them away from despair.
Participation offers purpose and encouragement even though the drug's benefit is not yet known.

tasks.prompt: Write a short explanation for a potential participant using the terms “placebo”, “cognitive tests” and “active treatment”.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להשתמש בשלושת המונחים במדויק ולהסביר את מבנה המחקר ללא הבטחה רפואית.
expected_points: Explain that one group receives a placebo or dummy treatment for comparison.
Explain that other groups receive an active treatment.
State that regular cognitive tests help researchers measure changes in thinking.
Avoid claiming that either medicine has already been proved effective.
